protocol.selection_order: All scope exclusions by registry_order, then all exceptions by counselor_programme_id; resume by audit_population plus counselor_programme_id.
protocol.population_start: Current normalized data/registry/programmes.csv; upstream DUO/RIO population is out of scope.
protocol.confirmed_meaning: Supports only the facts and decision within audit_scope. For no-defensible-ucr-match, confirmation applies only to external-programme basis; UCR reassessment remains pending.
protocol.outdated_rule: Requires dated evidence establishing that the original decision was supportable and that a later change superseded it. Record temporal uncertainty explicitly when historical evidence cannot distinguish incorrect from outdated.
protocol.resolved_external_curriculum_action: Normally reassess-exception: an externally reconstructable comparator alone does not establish UCR feasibility.
protocol.reprocess_as_comparison_rule: Recommend only when comparison eligibility is independently established; do not infer it merely from resolved external evidence.
protocol.incomplete_batches: Keep pending cases explicit without audit_finding; never count pending cases as audited.
protocol.final_reconciliation: Every excluded target and every current exception must have exactly one completed audit entry per audit_population; report missing in-scope records separately.

reconciliation_evidence.exception_type_check: Read all 140 exception canonical JSON records directly; verified their IDs and recordStatus and inventoried exception.type only. This is population enumeration, not exception research.
reconciliation_evidence.comparison_count_basis: Current generated review index, with its complete ID set reconciled to both registry scope and canonical filenames; comparison contents were not audited.
